question: What viscosity organs already exist, what do they own, and what must be split so a planted W can be stiff?
coordinateSpaces: Contour low-pass lives in content px after pose, before paint. tau seconds. sa = 1 − exp(−dt/τ). Default τ = 0.25 s (D-0022). Factory Wispwalker viscoTau 0.25. Capability range 0.02–1.0 s. Separate organ: MOMENTUM_RIG CoM damper (cLow 1.8, cHigh 0.6, N37 +20%). Kernel plant is world u; painter then smears x/y.
physicalLaw: Kelvin–Voigt retardation: ε(t) → ε∞ (1 − e^(−t/τ)), τ = η/E. Gasper’s sa = 1 − exp(−dt/τ) is that first-order creep on contour x/y.
One τ implies homogeneous rubber. A planted contact is high E (τ → 0). A free limb is finite η (τ ~ 0.25 s).
D-0018: the low-pass exists to kill ~80 Hz cusp buzz, not to author gait. Slow walk/breath must pass. Face is not smoothed.
N37 settle viscosity is the CoM spring-damper (cLow/cHigh), not viscoTau. Tuning Weight does not tune ringdown, and tuning bounce does not stiffen the W.
A world-locked plant that then enters the same τ as the swing is unlocked by construction. The floor cannot be clay and fact at once.
artisticLaw: Weight is how heavy the free mass feels, not how much the floor slides.
One pearl. No shoes. Planted nub stays on the floor place; swing is the only soft part.
N37: keep natural bounciness during motion. Settle the post-arrest bubble. Do not kill life to harden the plant.
invariants: Do not delete D-0018. The buzz kill stays on the unspecialized hull.
Do not raise global viscoTau to fake a solid plant. That smears the swing and the face-adjacent hull.
Do not retune MOMENTUM_RIG to fix the W. Different organ.
Do not add a W-skeleton this receipt. Explore only.
